title: Lengths of Parsed Fields
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, and let $y$ be a Boolean word. If parsing $y$ with the number of bits determined by the state set and number of work tapes of $M$ succeeds, yielding a bit vector and three words $t,a,x$, then $|t|\le |y|$ and $|a|\le |y|$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
Parsing $y$ succeeds and yields the indicated bit vector and words $t,a,x$
